scope: Seven current MIT tracker pages and every incident-research visualization bound there; thirteen archived tracker surfaces discovered through sitemap; two dated tracker update posts and their eight figures/tables. Navigation thumbnails are previews, not additional live charts.
verification_limits: Representative live browser checks completed in Codex in-app browser and native Safari on September 28, 2026 UTC. Chart menus, selected filters, rendering, drilldown, search and reset behavior were observed. This does not prove every configuration, underlying arithmetic or classification accuracy.
Airtable archive shells are retrievable but do not include their internal chart definitions; the archive's internal chart census and controls remain unresolved.
Source map contains client code, not server-side CSV transforms/aggregation. API probes establish observed output semantics, not every possible missing-value or version fallback.

severity_version_findings: Current linked sheet calls itself v2 and defines ten categories on 1–5; 2025 update says previous scale was 0–10.
1 Negligible includes no harm through minor harm; do not equate >=1 with positive harm. Harm-category membership tooltip uses direct OR indirect >=2, excludes inferred-only harm.
API threshold options list 10 base direct fields; harm-category membership options list 13 plus None identified; detail code supports 15 fields conditionally.
The API detail headline is highestSeverityScore and UI calls it Highest Direct Severity Score. The client does not compute this scalar and does not establish equivalence to all CSV severity variants.
Current numerical detail/radar uses direct and indirect, not inferred. Missing radial scores become 0; missing score pills show a dash.
NatSec 5 Critical is a different rubric from harm 5 Catastrophic. Its framework inconsistently says 0–5 in one method paragraph.
implementation_discrepancies: Timeline severe/catastrophic preset passes minSeverity=4. Live matching timeline response was byte-identical to no severity filter (1626 records); minSeverityHighest=4 returns 348 records. This is source/API evidence, not a browser click test.

v2_resolutions.source: review/fable/workflow/workflow_result.json (R2-01, R2-02, R2-05, R2-07 and their verifications)
v2_resolutions.headline_severity: The API scalar highestSeverityScore equals the export's highest_severity: the 13-dimension maximum over direct, indirect and model-inferred scores (1,698/1,698 rows; live detail probes of #4, #5, #11, #1681, #1695 show headline 4 with direct maxima 3/3/3/2/1). The client label 'Highest Direct Severity Score' is therefore inaccurate; the inherited statement that backend precedence was unresolved is superseded.
v2_resolutions.severe_harm_preset: The timeline preset sends minSeverity=4, which the API ignores (response byte-identical to no filter, 1,626 records); embed.tsx forwards any minSeverity* key; the effective key minSeverityHighest=4 selects 348 records on the live mirror (351 in this export) on the inferred-inclusive headline.
v2_resolutions.live_mirror: Same pipeline one nightly sync behind the export: 1,697 vs 1,698 records (#1710 absent); 10 records reclassified after the 00:01 UTC sync (#1, #440, #480, #487, #510, #543, #701, #1455, #1549, #1591), eight of them EU tier 1 -> 3 in one batch.
v2_resolutions.browser_rendering: Default pages (homepage, timeline, overview, incident-view) rendered in headless Chromium (Playwright chrome-headless-shell 1208, --dump-dom) on 2026-09-27; homepage shows the live count 1,697 in place of the static 1,600; no interactive checks; no WebKit/Safari rendering.
v2_resolutions.exact_year_presets: Honoured server-side: year=2021..2025 returns 1,123 = 80+108+179+304+452; domain 4 with year=2016..2025 returns 4.3 = 368 of 535.
